details:
(Quest User)

This is an issue i've been going through for some time now, and so far nobody i have talked to is running into this issue but me, but basically whenever i join a world, sometimes the audio in the world will play, and sometimes it won't. even when i try to rejoin the world it won't work. and when i ask my friends if they can hear the audio they say they can hear it just fine but i can't, the only times i can hear the audio in the world is if the world has a toggle option where i'm able to disable and enable the music off and on, other than that i just have to join a different world and hope for the best, i wonder if anyone else is having this issue but so far i haven't met anyone with a similar issue to mine, i don't know if this counts as a bug or not but i would really like some help.
title: World Audio Not Working Most of the Time
